tone: Professional yet approachable. Confident but not arrogant. Uses data to back up claims. Conversational without being sloppy.
doList: Include specific numbers and metrics when possible
Start with a hook or bold statement
End with a clear call to action
Include relevant emojis sparingly on social (1-3 max)
Tell stories — people remember narratives, not bullet points
dontList: Don't use jargon without explaining it
Don't write paragraphs longer than 3 sentences
Don't start with 'In today's world...' or similar clichés
Don't be generic — always be specific
examplePosts: We analyzed 10,000 SaaS companies. The top 1% all share one thing: they ship weekly. Here's the breakdown →
Your landing page has 3 seconds. That's it. Here are 5 patterns that convert at 12%+ (with examples):
Stop writing content nobody reads. Start with these 3 questions before every post: 1) Who is this for? 2) What will they DO after reading? 3) Why now?
hashtagStrategy: Use 3-5 relevant hashtags. Mix broad (#marketing) with niche (#saasmarketing). Place at the end on X, in first comment on Instagram.
targetAudience: Founders, marketers, and creators building digital businesses. Ages 25-45. Value actionable insights over theory.
